transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed for the past two months, and I just can't seem to shake it. I've completely lost interest in all my hobbies and have absolutely no motivation to do anything anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change? If so, what happened?
No, I don't recall any specific stressful event or major life change that triggered these feelings. They just seemed to develop on their own and have been getting worse.
Before these past two months, have you felt down or low most days for at least two years? Or is this the first time you’ve had a depression like this?

No, I haven't felt down for two years, and this is the first time I've ever experienced a depression like this. It only started about two months ago, although I've been dealing with other strange experiences and symptoms for about a year and a month in total.
You mentioned other strange experiences for about a year—have you been hearing or seeing things others don’t, or strongly believing things that others say aren’t true?

Yes, for about 13 months now, I've been hearing things and holding onto beliefs that others tell me aren't true. I often hear whispering voices when I am completely alone, and I have this strong conviction that an organization is monitoring and watching my every move.
Before this depression started two months ago, were the voices and beliefs already happening when your mood was not depressed? If so, for about how long?

Yes, the voices and beliefs started long before the depression, about a year ago. I was dealing with them for about 11 months while my mood was still normal, before this depression set in. There was a long period where I heard the whispers and felt monitored without feeling down at all.
Over the whole 13 months of illness, have you been depressed for most of that time, or only for these last two months?
Actually, I have felt depressed for the majority of that 13-month period. It is just that the feelings of depression became much more severe and overwhelming over these last two months.

During the times you felt depressed, did you also have other symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, feeling worthless or guilty, or thoughts of death or suicide?

Yes, I've had terrible trouble sleeping, like struggling to fall asleep, waking up constantly, and waking up much too early. I also frequently have thoughts of death, sometimes wishing I just wouldn't wake up or wanting to end my life. I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite or felt guilty, though.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked faster, or acted more impulsively than usual?

No, I have never had a period where I felt unusually energized or euphoric like that. If anything, I've experienced the exact opposite, feeling completely drained, depressed, and having a lot of trouble sleeping.

Depressive symptoms have been present for the majority of the illness duration, with a current major depressive episode marked by depressed mood, anhedonia, insomnia, low motivation/energy, and recurrent thoughts of death.
